recommendation: Keep the audit commit as the durable reconciliation record for FHIR-36704. No follow-up source work is recommended unless a later work group decision changes global work group terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-36704 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction requesting that the Resource List tab labelled "By Committee" be changed to work group terminology, matching the terminology used for individual resource ownership.
initial_application: Jira records git 766bd40, and commit 766bd4052d40cc4a31c2f75be57913ce5f307290 changed source/resourcelist.html from "By Committee" to "By Work Group". The source change is present in the current branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini contains the active any=resourcelist entry, confirming source/resourcelist.html is in build scope. Current source/resourcelist.html line 36 says "By Work Group". Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting discussion or follow-up decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification source already implements the Jira request and no further source edit is needed.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the Resource List tab label use work group terminology instead of "By Committee".
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final requested correction for the current source check.

evidence_items.summary: source/fhir.ini has an active any=resourcelist entry and the current Resource List tab label is "By Work Group".
evidence_items.learned: The build-scope source already contains the requested corrected label.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit "Committee -> Work Group" changed source/resourcelist.html from "By Committee" to "By Work Group" and linked FHIR-36704.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira correction was applied directly in source before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.locator: Zulip and Confluence search for FHIR-36704 plus Resource List tab terms
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-36704" "Resource List" "By Committee" "By Work Group"' --limit 5; bun run zulip:search sql "SELECT id, stream_name, topic, datetime(timestamp, 'unixepoch') AS sent_at, substr(content,1,160) AS excerpt FROM messages WHERE content LIKE '%FHIR-36704%' OR (content LIKE '%Resource List%' AND (content LIKE '%By Committee%' OR content LIKE '%By Work Group%')) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10"; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-36704; bun run confluence:search fts '"FHIR-36704" "Resource List" "By Committee" "By Work Group"' --limit 5
evidence_items.query: FHIR-36704 Resource List By Committee By Work Group
evidence_items.summary: No directly relevant Zulip or Confluence hits were found.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community record changes the Jira/source conclusion.

evidence_items.command: rg -n 'By Committee|By Work Group|By Workgroup' source/resourcelist.html; rg -n '^any=resourcelist|resourcelist' source/fhir.ini
evidence_items.summary: The current Resource List source reports line 36 as "By Work Group" and fhir.ini reports line 84 as any=resourcelist.
evidence_items.learned: The requested correction is present in an active source page and the obsolete label is absent from that file.
